title: About Us
body: Innovating Pittsburgh is a recurring forum hosted at Carnegie Mellon University by the Olitsky Program of the Career & Professional Development Center and the Software and Societal Systems Department in the School of Computer Science.

The forum is organized by stakeholders committed to a shared mission: creating a network that fuels business impact and sustained neurodiversity-driven change. Our planning team lives the principle of "nothing about us without us"; more than half of the organizing team identify as neurodivergent.
